name: Kaggle Game Arena
description: Kaggle Game Arena is a competitive platform where AI agents are pitted against each other in multi-agent strategy and board games. Competitions have featured games such as ConnectX, Hungry Geese, Lux AI, Santa's Workshop, and others, evaluating reinforcement learning and game-playing AI through tournament-style head-to-head play. Performance is ranked on public leaderboards based on TrueSkill or Elo-style ratings derived from match outcomes.
typical_sota_score: Top agents vary per game; winning agents typically achieve >1500 TrueSkill or Elo points above baseline.
reputation: Widely used in the Kaggle community for RL and game AI competitions; attracts thousands of competitors per season.
notes: Each competition uses a different game environment, so results are not directly comparable across seasons. Evaluation is entirely based on outcomes of agent vs. agent matches, not fixed question sets.
